quest.title: Margaret's Longing
quest.description: While Jean is ill from overwork, you've been tasked with handling some citizens' commissions on her behalf. Where has Margaret's pet cat Prince run off to this time?
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Mora x18000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: ...So, yours is the cat that went missing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Venti! Have you come to help?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Me, here to help you? Why, on the contrary, it is I who needs helping!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But Paimon just saw you talking to Margaret about Prince...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Aha! So, Prince is the name of the feline fiend who thieved my spare <color=#00E1FFFF>astral iron strings</color>!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Though it gladdens my heart to see that the free-spirited ethos of Mondstadt is alive and well in creatures great and small... Still, it's a bit audacious!

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Haha, Prince is a mischievous little rascal alright!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Spoken just like a parent who chooses to spoil said rascal!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Indeed. Just like Barbatos...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Ahaha, yes, quite... quite... Ahem! Now, let's see about getting ourselves an audience with his little highness, Prince Rascal of Mondstadt!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I have a performance tonight, and without my spare strings, I shall have to disappoint my audience.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What would a kitty cat want with lyre strings anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Everyone knows cats go crazy for a ball of string!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What!?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: These lyre strings are made of astral iron, which contains Anemo energy. That makes them extremely durable, so I normally just roll them up in a ball to make them easier to carry.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: That's a trick of the trade from a traveling bard!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The strings contain Anemo energy?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #That'll help us! {NICKNAME}, it's time for you to use your <color=#00E1FFFF>Elemental Sight</color> again!

talks.objective: Find Margaret and ask about her commission

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Where have you been looking?

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Prince should be somewhere around the Marketplace. Remember, he's got black fur.

dialogues.speaker: Kitten
dialogues.text: Meow!

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Prince should be somewhere around the Marketplace. Remember, he's got black fur.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, Prince has very keen senses. It didn't take much to scare him off.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: See if you can approach him crouching <color=#00E1FFFF>from behind</color>. That way, your footsteps will be quieter.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It must be difficult not being able to float, hee-hee.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If you're anxious to find Prince, why not coax him to you with some <color=#00E1FFFF>Fish</color>? Kitty cats do love eating fish.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If you've run out of <color=#00E1FFFF>Fish</color>, go grab some more from the lake. Now, back to it!

talks.objective: Talk to Margaret to finish your commission.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Drat! He's run off again.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But where is he going? Hmm, Paimon wonders if...

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Prince! Good boy, that's my Prince, I knew you'd come home to me...

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Prince! Where did you go running off to? Thank goodness you're safe...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He made sure we had our work cut out for us looking for him.

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Oh Princey, how could you leave me like that...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like those two need some time to themselves...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And here are your astral iron strings, Venti.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: You found them! Wonderful! I was not optimistic they would turn up.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I daresay that a private performance played using these very same strings would not be an excessive way to show my gratitude! ...Ah, ah...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah what?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: ACHOO!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: *cough* Haha... Apologies. At this distance, my cat allergy seems to be rearing its head...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, now Paimon gets why you didn't go looking for your strings by yourself...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hehe, anyway, thanks for the help, I'll be going now— a—achoo!
